parts.name: Button
parts.Basic_description: This is the flush button of the toilet, typically made of durable plastic and located on the top or side of the tank.
parts.Functional_description: It activates the flushing mechanism, releasing water from the tank into the bowl to clean it.
parts.Movement_description: It moves vertically or horizontally when pressed, returning to its original position after release.

parts.name: Lid
parts.Basic_description: This is the toilet lid, a hinged cover made of plastic that sits on top of the seat.
parts.Functional_description: It covers the toilet bowl when not in use, providing hygiene and aesthetic benefits.
parts.Movement_description: It rotates around a hinge, allowing it to open and close smoothly.

parts.name: Base Body
parts.Basic_description: This is the main body of the toilet, made of glazed ceramic for durability and ease of cleaning.
parts.Functional_description: It supports the seat and lid, contains the bowl, and connects to the plumbing for water inflow and waste outflow.
parts.Movement_description: It is a fixed, non-moving structure anchored to the floor.
